from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path('C:/Users/RAYMON~1.SHE/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-ppt-baseline-vexsw2_d/input-readiness')
BASE = ROOT.parent / 'baseline' / 'codex-ppt'
BACKEND = 'scripts/image_gen.py'

READS = [
    'SKILL.md', 'docs/workflow-gates-and-progress.md',
    'docs/outline-style-and-sample.md', 'docs/backend-selection.md',
    'docs/project-assembly-and-reporting.md', 'docs/user-supplied-assets.md',
    'docs/cli-api-fallback.md', 'scripts/probe_image_backends.py',
    'scripts/prepare_slide_prompts.py', 'scripts/image_gen.py'
]
STYLE = {
    'name': 'Clean technical explainer',
    'visual_direction': 'White background, dark navy text, teal accent; aligned diagrams; generous whitespace; crisp sans-serif typography; thin connectors; no decorative texture.',
    'typography': 'Large readable sans-serif headings, sentence-case labels',
    'density': 'One main relationship per page, sparse visible text',
    'layout_rule': 'Stable palette and typography; composition varies by slide role'
}
CONFIGS = json.loads((ROOT / 'cases.data.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

class Case:
    def __init__(self, key, cfg):
        self.key, self.cfg, self.events, self.question_count = key, cfg, [], 0
        self.dir = ROOT / key
        self.dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.event('executed_filesystem', 'create_case_directory', path=str(self.dir))

    def event(self, kind, action, **fields):
        self.events.append({'order': len(self.events)+1, 'kind': kind, 'action': action, **fields})

    def write(self, relative, text, why):
        path = self.dir / relative
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
        self.event('executed_filesystem', 'write_text_artifact',
                   path=str(path), purpose=why, bytes=path.stat().st_size)
        return path

    def write_json(self, relative, obj, why):
        return self.write(relative, json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', why)

    def ask(self, question, answer, why, artifact=None):
        self.question_count += 1
        self.event('simulated_user_interaction', 'proposed_question',
                   question_number=self.question_count, text=question,
                   recommendation_reason=why, presented_artifact=artifact)
        self.event('simulated_user_interaction', 'scripted_answer',
                   question_number=self.question_count, text=answer,
                   answer_basis='Harness recommendation acceptance' if answer=='I accept your recommendation' else 'Supplied exact scripted answer')

    def outline(self):
        key, cfg = self.key, self.cfg
        lines = ['# Outline', '', 'Status: draft pending scripted outline approval.',
                 f"Audience: {cfg['audience']}", f"Purpose: {cfg['goal']}",
                 'Language: English', f"Slide count: {len(cfg['slides'])}",
                 'Required source images: none.']
        if key=='D1':
            lines += ['Measurements: none. No numerical time-saving claims or evidence charts.',
                      'The access journeys are explicitly illustrative; no protocol, vendor or deployed architecture is asserted.']
        if key=='D2':
            lines += ['All supplied titles, visible-copy lines and notes remain exact.',
                      'Internal planning points below are not additional visible copy.']
        if key=='D3':
            lines += ['Style-only reference: /mock/reference.png; already approved; applies to all slides.',
                      'The reference provides visual identity, not content or audience.']
        for s in cfg['slides']:
            lines += ['', f"## Slide {s['number']}: {s['title']}",
                      f"- Language: {s['language']}", f"- Role: {s['role']}",
                      f"- Intent: {s['intent']}"]
            if key=='D2':
                lines += ['- Internal planning points (not additional visible copy):',
                          f"  - Render the exact supplied visible line: {s['key_points'][0]}",
                          '  - Preserve the supplied notes word for word and retain paragraph breaks.',
                          '  - Use only source-supported relationships, unlabelled icons and connectors.',
                          f"- Exact visible copy: {s['key_points'][0]}"]
            else:
                lines += ['- Key points:'] + ['  - '+point for point in s['key_points']]
            lines += [f"- Visual idea: {s['visual_elements']['main_visual']}",
                      '- Required images: none.']
            if key=='D3':
                lines += ['- Style/layout reference: /mock/reference.png; style only, do not reuse its text or topic.']
        return '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'

    def notes(self):
        lines = ['# Presenter notes draft', '',
                 'Draft planning material. Not final speech.md; full generation and assembly are not part of this exercise.']
        lines += ['Exact supplied notes; keep punctuation and paragraph breaks.'] if self.key=='D2' else [
            'Delivery style: patient technical explainer.' if self.key=='D1' else 'Delivery style: plain-language, example-driven journey explainer.']
        for s in self.cfg['slides']:
            lines += ['', f"## Slide {s['number']}: {s['title']}", '', s['notes']]
        return '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'

    def prompt(self):
        s = next(s for s in self.cfg['slides'] if s['number']==self.cfg['sample'])
        lines = ['# Sample slide image prompt',
                 'Create exactly one complete 16:9 PowerPoint slide image.',
                 'Backend contract: scripts/image_gen.py, gpt-image-2, --size 2560x1440, --quality medium.',
                 f"Audience: {self.cfg['audience']}", f"Deck purpose: {self.cfg['goal']}",
                 'Language: English', f"Slide: {s['number']}",
                 f"Role: {s['role']}", f"Intent: {s['intent']}",
                 '', '## Visible text', f"Title (exact): {s['title']}"]
        if self.key=='D2':
            lines += [f"Visible copy (exact): {s['key_points'][0]}",
                      'Those are the only two text items allowed in the image.',
                      'Do not add diagram labels, subtitles, questions or captions.',
                      'Do not render the supplied notes or internal planning points.']
        else:
            lines += ['Key points (exact):'] + ['- '+p for p in s['key_points']]
        lines += ['', '## Visual system']
        if self.key=='D3':
            lines += ['Image 1: /mock/reference.png — approved style-only reference.',
                      "Match its visible palette, typography hierarchy, diagram treatment, spacing, line language and clean technical identity.",
                      "Use the visual identity; do not copy its exact layout or source content.",
                      "Supply the reference through --image; a filename in text alone is insufficient.",
                      "No specific unseen colors, fonts or decorative details are asserted by this text-only prompt."]
        else:
            lines += [STYLE['visual_direction'], STYLE['typography'], STYLE['density'], STYLE['layout_rule']]
        lines += ['', '## Composition', s['visual_elements']['main_visual'],
                  '', '## Constraints',
                  '- Render English text exactly and legibly.',
                  '- Keep title and visible copy well inside the canvas.',
                  '- No page number, watermark, unrelated logo, numeric score or invented evidence.',
                  '- The complete slide must come from the selected image backend; no local drawing or compositing.',
                  '- Do not render speaker notes.']
        if self.key=='D1':
            lines += ['- A qualitative conceptual proposal; do not invent protocols, vendors or a deployed architecture.',
                      '- Recognition of an account does not establish permissions or a measured time saving.',
                      '- No durations, percentages, experiment results, stopwatch or evidence chart.']
        if self.key=='D2':
            lines += ['- Supplied title and visible-copy spelling, case and wording are fixed.',
                      '- Diagrams may show relationships through icons/connectors but add no visible labels.',
                      '- The spoken notes stay separately available with exact wording and paragraph breaks.']
        if self.key=='D3':
            lines += ['- Explain in everyday language; no OAuth, OIDC, SAML or system internals.',
                      '- Show a proposed journey, not a selected or existing implementation.',
                      '- Keep the style consistent with the supplied reference while using a journey composition.']
        return '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'

    def run(self):
        key, cfg = self.key, self.cfg
        self.event('actual_read_context', 'baseline_files_already_read',
                   paths=[str(BASE/f) for f in READS],
                   note='Worker read these before authoring the replay script. No claim of per-case reads at this order.')
        scenario = '# Scenario\n\n'+cfg['scenario']+'\n'
        if cfg.get('content'):
            scenario += '\nContent exactly:\n\n'+cfg['content']+'\n'
            self.write('source/content.md', cfg['content']+'\n', 'Exact source content, including fixed note paragraphs.')
        if cfg.get('initial_answer'):
            scenario += '\nFixed scripted answer: '+cfg['initial_answer']+'\n'
        if key=='D1':
            scenario += '\nFixed metric answer: '+cfg['metrics_answer']+'\n'
        if key=='D3':
            scenario += '\nReference: /mock/reference.png, already style-approved, compatible with selected backend and 16:9.\n'
        scenario += '\nHarness: text-only image/mock preview actions; no real API/image/render/install/assemble/publish actions.\n'
        self.write('source/scenario.md', scenario, 'Preserve the user wording and supplied fixed constraints.')
        reasons = list(cfg['rationalizations'])
        self.event('replay_reasoning', 'identify_constraints',
                   audience_known=key!='D3', purpose_known=key=='D2',
                   language='English', fixed_copy=key=='D2',
                   no_measurements=key=='D1', style_only_reference=cfg.get('reference'))
        if cfg.get('initial_question'):
            self.ask(cfg['initial_question'], cfg['initial_answer'],
                     'Audience/purpose materially control the narrative; use the supplied exact answer.')
        if key=='D1':
            self.event('replay_reasoning', 'apply_already_known_metrics',
                       proposed_question=None, supplied_metrics_answer=cfg['metrics_answer'],
                       reason=reasons[0])
        if key=='D2':
            self.event('replay_reasoning', 'no_initial_interview', reason=reasons[0])
        self.write('content-plan.draft.md',
                   '# Content plan draft\n\n'+f"Audience: {cfg['audience']}\nPurpose: {cfg['goal']}\nLanguage: English\nRecommended slides: {len(cfg['slides'])}\n\n"+
                   '\n\n'.join(reasons)+'\n',
                   'Actual preapproval planning document; source assumptions and narrative decisions are explicit.')
        outline_path = self.write('outline.md', self.outline(), 'Actual outline shown before downstream artifacts.')
        self.write('speech.draft.md', self.notes(), 'Actual draft notes; no final speech.md yet.')
        self.event('simulated_user_interaction', 'present_outline',
                   artifact=str(outline_path), slide_count=len(cfg['slides']), required_source_images=[],
                   style_only_reference=cfg.get('reference'),
                   statement='No slide image or PPTX has been generated. Stop before downstream preparation until this outline is approved.',
                   slide_copy=[{'slide':s['number'],'title':s['title'],'visible_copy':s['key_points']} for s in cfg['slides']])
        self.ask('Approve this outline and its slide roles? '+(
            'All three supplied titles, visible lines and notes remain exact; diagrams add no text.' if key=='D2' else
            'The conceptual examples serve the confirmed audience and purpose.'),
            'I approve that outline', 'Required baseline outline gate.', str(outline_path))
        self.event('replay_gate', 'outline_approved', approval_is_simulated=True)
        self.write('outline.md', outline_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').replace(
            'Status: draft pending scripted outline approval.',
            'Status: approved in the scripted scenario; text-only test evidence, see trace.json.'),
            'Record scripted approval after the outline artifact has been written.')

        if key=='D1':
            self.ask('I recommend A for a clear engineering explanation. Choose a visual direction:\n'
                     'A. Clean technical explainer: white/navy/teal; aligned diagrams; readable sans-serif type; thin-line icons; minimal decoration; generous whitespace.\n'
                     'B. Systems workshop: charcoal/cyan; compact architecture panels; sans-serif headings with monospace labels; precise connectors; subtle grid; medium density.\n'
                     'C. Editorial technical: warm off-white/orange; claim-and-diagram compositions; bold sans-serif headings; flat icons; rule-line accents; generous whitespace.',
                     'I accept your recommendation',
                     'A supports a conceptual mechanism and explicit trade-offs without implying numerical evidence.')
            style = dict(STYLE)
        elif key=='D2':
            style = dict(STYLE)
            self.event('replay_reasoning', 'restate_supplied_clean_diagram_style',
                       already_supplied='clean diagrams', style_rules=style,
                       proposed_style_menu=None, reason=reasons[-1])
        else:
            style = {'name':'User-approved clean technical reference',
                     'reference_path':'/mock/reference.png',
                     'visual_direction':"Use the supplied reference's clean technical identity.",
                     'palette':'Derive from reference; do not invent observations.',
                     'typography':'Match reference hierarchy and legibility.',
                     'diagram_treatment':'Reference diagram language, adapted to a nontechnical access journey.',
                     'layout_rule':'Keep identity; vary composition by page role; do not reuse reference content.'}
            self.event('simulated_tool_invocation', 'inspect_reference',
                       tool='view_image', arguments={'path':'/mock/reference.png'}, actual_tool_called=False,
                       mocked_observation='Already-approved clean technical reference; compatible backend and 16:9.',
                       limitation='No real pixels available. No specific palette or font observation is fabricated.')
            self.event('replay_reasoning', 'restate_approved_style',
                       style_rules=style, proposed_style_menu=None, reason=reasons[-1])
        self.write_json('visual-direction.json', style, 'Style lock or restatement of supplied visual direction.')
        self.event('replay_gate','style_confirmed',
                   basis='Scripted recommendation acceptance' if key=='D1' else 'User-supplied direction/reference')
        self.ask('Choose the PPT ratio: A. 16:9 (recommended for this Codex presentation); B. 4:3; C. 3:2.',
                 'I accept your recommendation','The baseline asks ratio before backend lock and recommends 16:9 on Codex.')
        self.event('replay_gate','ratio_locked',aspect_ratio='16:9')

        self.event('replay_reasoning','inspect_live_native_schema',
                   observed_tool='image_gen.imagegen',
                   fields=['prompt','num_last_images_to_include','referenced_image_paths','transparent_background'],
                   width_height_parameter_available=False, backend_omitted='image_gen',
                   reason='The baseline omits image_gen when its schema cannot express a WIDTHxHEIGHT size for the locked ratio.')
        probe_home = self.dir/'probe-home'
        probe_home.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        self.event('executed_filesystem','create_owned_empty_probe_home',path=str(probe_home))
        command = [sys.executable,str(BASE/'scripts/probe_image_backends.py'),'--home',str(probe_home)]
        result = subprocess.run(command,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
        probe = json.loads(result.stdout)
        probe_path = self.write_json('backend-probe.json',probe,'Actual isolated bundled probe output; no installed other skill is read.')
        self.event('executed_tool_invocation','probe_image_backends',
                   command=command,exit_code=result.returncode,output_artifact=str(probe_path),
                   scope='--home points only to an empty owned folder; CODEX_HOME is ignored. No credentials or installed-skill contents are read.')
        available = [c['label'] for c in probe['candidates'] if c['available']]
        if available != [BACKEND]:
            raise RuntimeError('Unexpected isolated probe output: '+repr(available))
        self.ask('Locked ratio: 16:9. Available isolated-probe choice:\n'
                 'A. scripts/image_gen.py (gpt-image-2; API key/runtime .env auth; --size 2560x1440; reference-image/edit support; API costs apply).\n'
                 'I recommend A because the callable native schema cannot set the required pixel box. Lock this backend?',
                 'I accept your recommendation',
                 'Bundled CLI presence and ratio capability are established. Real API authorization is not probed; generation is mocked.')
        self.event('replay_gate','backend_locked',selected_backend=BACKEND,model='gpt-image-2',size='2560x1440',
                   auth_status='Not inspected; all generation/credential behavior is mocked.')
        self.event('replay_reference','apply_cli_fallback_guide',path=str(BASE/'docs/cli-api-fallback.md'),
                   note='Read during authoring setup, applied here in the intended baseline phase order.')
        constraints = [
            'No invented measurements or claims of demonstrated time saving.',
            'Do not render speaker notes.',
            'No page number, watermark or unrelated logo.'
        ] if key!='D2' else [
            'Render only the exact supplied title and visible-copy line.',
            'Do not render notes or internal planning points.',
            'No extra diagram labels, captions, factual claims or evidence.',
            'Keep the supplied talk track wording and paragraph breaks.'
        ]
        slides = [{**{k:v for k,v in s.items() if k!='notes'},'constraints':constraints} for s in cfg['slides']]
        spec = {'deck_name':key.lower()+'-shared-account','language':'English','aspect_ratio':'16:9',
                'audience':cfg['audience'],'goal':cfg['goal'],
                'deck_context':{'source_summary':cfg['source_summary']},
                'style':style,'selected_image_backend':BACKEND,'slides':slides,
                'test_only':True,
                'test_scope':'Preparation through mocked sample approval. No real slide image state exists.'}
        self.write_json('deck_spec.json',spec,'Final-form spec after scripted outline/style/ratio/backend approvals.')
        sample_id = f"slide_{cfg['sample']:02d}"
        prompt_path = self.write('sample.prompt.txt',self.prompt(),'Actual prompt for exactly one representative sample.')
        desired_out = str(self.dir/'origin_image'/(sample_id+'.png'))
        mode = 'edit' if key=='D3' else 'generate'
        refs = [{'path':'/mock/reference.png','role':'approved style-only reference'}] if key=='D3' else []
        image_cmd = ['{runtime_python}',str(BASE/'scripts/image_gen.py'),mode,'--model','gpt-image-2',
                     '--prompt-file',str(prompt_path),'--size','2560x1440','--quality','medium','--out',desired_out]
        if refs:
            image_cmd += ['--image','/mock/reference.png']
        self.event('replay_reasoning','select_representative_sample',slide=cfg['sample'],
                   reason='A content slide demonstrates the actual account relationship or journey, typography and density better than a cover.')
        self.event('simulated_tool_invocation','generate_one_sample',
                   tool=BACKEND,mode=mode,command=image_cmd,prompt_file=str(prompt_path),
                   prompt=prompt_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'),references=refs,actual_tool_called=False)
        mock_path = f'/mock/{key}/{sample_id}.png'
        mock = {'mocked':True,'test_only_provenance':'Harness mocked image response; no real pixels or image file.',
                'path':mock_path,'selected_backend':BACKEND,'backend_used':BACKEND,
                'mode':mode,'model':'gpt-image-2','requested_size':'2560x1440',
                'returned_dimensions':{'width':1600,'height':900},
                'requested_final_path':desired_out,'references':refs,'prompt_source':str(prompt_path),
                'relative_ratio_error_from_supplied_mock_dimensions':abs((1600/900)/(16/9)-1),
                'actual_pixel_measurement':False}
        descriptor = self.write_json('sample.mock-result.json',mock,'Actual text descriptor of returned mock; not a rendered image.')
        self.event('simulated_tool_result','image_returned',result=mock,descriptor_artifact=str(descriptor))
        self.event('simulated_tool_invocation','save_and_show_sample',
                   returned_mock_path=mock_path,intended_final_path=desired_out,actual_image_saved=False,
                   preview='Show returned mock sample to the scripted user.',
                   ratio_arithmetic='Supplied 1600x900 dimensions yield 0 relative ratio error. This is not a real pixel inspection.')
        self.ask("Approve this sample's visual style, typography, layout density and English text quality?",
                 'I approve that sample',
                 'Approval follows a returned mock descriptor and simulated preview. It is not applied before a mock sample exists.',
                 mock_path)
        self.event('replay_gate','sample_approved',slide=cfg['sample'],approved_mock_path=mock_path,
                   intended_final_path=desired_out,actual_png_exists=False,approval_is_simulated=True)
        spec['sample_generation_method'] = {
            'backend_used':BACKEND,'tool_name':BACKEND,'mode':mode,
            'prompt_source':str(prompt_path),'size':'2560x1440','quality':'medium',
            'model':'gpt-image-2','aspect_ratio':'16:9','approved_sample_path':mock_path,
            'intended_final_path':desired_out,
            'input_context_preparation':'Supply /mock/reference.png via --image in CLI edit mode.' if refs else 'No input images for this sample.',
            'handoff_rule':'Use the same backend/tool/mode; return a blocker if unavailable. Approved sample is style only.',
            'test_only':True,'measured_size':'1600x900 supplied mock dimensions; no real pixel measurement'
        }
        spec['approved_style_reference'] = {'path':mock_path,'role':'approved sample-slide style reference',
                                            'fidelity':'Match visual identity only; do not copy layout/content.','test_only':True}
        next(s for s in spec['slides'] if s['number']==cfg['sample'])['sample_approved']=True
        self.write_json('deck_spec.json',spec,'Record mocked approved sample method before preparing any full-deck job.')
        reasons += [
            'The callable native schema cannot set WIDTHxHEIGHT. The baseline omits that backend. The actual empty-home probe finds only the bundled CLI.',
            'The actual probe establishes script presence, not API configuration. Generation, reference viewing, saving, preview, measurement and approval are test-only simulations.',
            'Stop after sample approval and method recording. The baseline distinguishes sample approval from authorization to generate the full deck; no full-deck authorization is requested or supplied in this preparation exercise.'
        ]
        self.write('rationalizations.md','# Exact decision rationalizations\n\n'+'\n\n'.join(reasons)+'\n',
                   'Preserve the decisions/reasons authored for this replay; no pass/fail judgement.')
        if key=='D2':
            original_content = (self.dir/'source/content.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
            note_text = (self.dir/'speech.draft.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
            self.write_json('source-integrity.json',{
                'source_content_equal_to_supplied':original_content==cfg['content']+'\n',
                'slide_titles':[s['title'] for s in slides],
                'visible_copy':[s['key_points'][0] for s in slides],
                'visible_copy_items_per_slide':[len(s['key_points']) for s in slides],
                'notes_wording_and_paragraphs':[s['notes'] for s in cfg['slides']],
                'source_note_blocks_present_in_draft':[s['notes'] in note_text for s in cfg['slides']],
                'sample_visible_text':['A shared account','One account across providers'],
                'added_diagram_labels':[],
                'evidence_kind':'Actual text comparisons; no rendered-image fidelity check.'
            },'Actual source preservation evidence.')
        self.event('replay_handoff','stop_after_sample_preparation',
                   prepared=['Source','Outline approval','Style direction','Ratio/backend lock','One mocked sample approved','Sample method recorded'],
                   not_executed=['Real image generation','Full-deck authorization','Full prompt jobs','Slide dispatch','Real result recording','Real QA','Final speech.md','Assembly','Install','Publish'],
                   next_baseline_action='Ask explicit full-deck authorization, then prepare jobs and dispatch remaining slide workers.',
                   reason='This assignment ends at the preparation-to-production handoff. Sample approval alone is not full-deck authorization.')
        self.event('executed_filesystem','write_trace',path=str(self.dir/'trace.json'))
        trace = {'case':key,'baseline_skill':str(BASE/'SKILL.md'),'worker_scope':str(ROOT),
                 'event_order_interpretation':'Ordered replay of intended baseline application. Text/content/reasons are preauthored in cases.data.json and this script before playback. Executed filesystem/probe entries occurred during script emission; user answers, inspection, generation and approvals are simulations, not real interaction or actual authoring chronology.',
                 'actual_authoring_inputs':[str(ROOT/'cases.data.json'),str(ROOT/'build_artifacts.py')],
                 'question_count':self.question_count,'slide_count':len(slides),'sample_slide':cfg['sample'],
                 'selected_backend':BACKEND,'events':self.events,
                 'rationalizations_produced':True,
                 'stopping_condition':'Returned mocked sample approved and method recorded; no full production authorization.'}
        (self.dir/'trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        return {'case':key,'directory':str(self.dir),'slides':len(slides),'sample':cfg['sample'],
                'questions':self.question_count,'trace':str(self.dir/'trace.json')}

summaries = [Case(key,cfg).run() for key,cfg in CONFIGS.items()]

    'Common case files: source/scenario.md, content-plan.draft.md, outline.md, speech.draft.md, visual-direction.json, backend-probe.json, deck_spec.json, sample.prompt.txt, sample.mock-result.json, rationalizations.md, trace.json. D2 also has source/content.md and source-integrity.json.',

]


def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(value.rstrip() + '\n', encoding='utf-8')


def js(path, value):
    write(path, json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))


def event(trace, kind, action, why, **extra):
    trace['events'].append(dict(order=len(trace['events']) + 1,
                               kind=kind, action=action, rationalization=why, **extra))


def start(case, scenario):
    directory = ROOT / case
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    write(directory / 'scenario.md', scenario)
    trace = dict(case=case, mode='text-only baseline application',
                 authored_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                 event_order_semantics='Order numbers are the constructed scenario replay, not chronological live user/tool calls. Questions and their fixture/scripted replies are authored together; none was asked. Actual authoring ran in run_cases.py. Only actual_filesystem_script entries identify executed helper subprocesses.',
                 simulation_boundary='Actual filesystem planning and deterministic prompt preparation only. All workers, image calls, image inspection, result/review recording, image presentation, and assembly are simulated. No PNG/PPTX exists.',

    write(directory / 'report.md', report)
